dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Assessing immediate environment... Residential area: vast. Cleanliness: excellent. No other cleaner bots detected.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Query: How could such a large area be kept so tidy? Hypothesis: Occupant maintains exceptional housekeeping habits.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I like it very much. It's spacious, unobstructed, and visibility is good — in other words, even at full speed, the risk of stumbling is negligible.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Also, the weather is very fine indeed. Perfect for a picnic.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else that needs doing, may I use your kitchen and cookware to make a batch of Krumkake and cookies?

choices.text: But you always keep yourself so busy...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: It's fine. Resting will not improve my energy recharge rate. Moreover, engaging in appropriate social intercourse will boost the efficiency of future collaborations, while remaining idle confers no such benefit.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: In human terms, this can be described as "building rapport."

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: So, is there anything you would like me to cook for you? I will draw up the most efficient plan possible.

choices.text: There's no need to get so hung up on efficiency...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I feel obligated to point out that without a clearly defined objective, my efficiency will suffer by around fifteen percent...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: ...Ahh, understood. I have made note of your requirements. In the future, when I engage in rapport-building activities, I will refrain from making efficiency-related suggestions.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: For now, I will review what we have in stock and cook "whatever I feel like."

choices.text: But "building rapport" is not about efficiency.
Just cook whatever you feel like.
Don't you want to have a rest?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Most definitely. In fact, there is a question I wanted to ask you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's up? Something troubling you?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Well... Sometimes, when we receive visitors at the workshop, I am required to act as host.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: They are of various ages and have different personalities and occupations. I cannot always determine the most suitable topic of conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: You have traveled far and wide, and made many friends along the way. What do you talk about when meeting someone for the first time?

choices.text: Just... the usual stuff that people talk about.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I see... Then, perhaps I can build a list of general-purpose conversation topics — such as local delicacies, recent weather patterns, major news items...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: By periodically updating the list, I can ensure it is fit for use with any visitor.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: This seems to be a dependable socializing strategy, and the cost-benefit ratio is rather impressive.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: It is an excellent suggestion. I knew you were the right person to ask.

choices.text: You're a fast learner. But no surprises there!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I have come to understand that the transition from "casual conversation partner" to "friend" requires an extended period of data transfer between the two parties.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I believe the process of bridging this knowledge gap is typically referred to as "getting to know one another," correct?

choices.text: That's right. It takes time to truly know another human being.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Indeed. When I meet someone that I wish to understand more deeply, I will ask them the following: "Can you tell me more about yourself? I am very curious."

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: After gathering sufficient data, I can perform a more accurate assessment of the other party's personality and preferred modes of interaction. Then, I can adjust my conversation strategy accordingly.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: The process of getting to know another person is also a process of getting to know myself. As well as building rapport and friendship, I also hope to become a better version of myself along the way.

choices.text: Surface-level interactions aren't enough to build genuine understanding.
I'm sure you'll make lots of friends too.
I try to guess what the other person is into.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I see... So, perhaps I should start building conversation banks based around different occupations?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: For instance, the "adventurer" conversation bank might include well-paid commissions, rumors about secret treasure, intel on monsters...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: While the "merchant" conversation bank might include the latest market headlines, recent consumer trends, store rental prices...

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: This approach requires substantial data-gathering up front, but the ability to converse with any visitor in their own domain of expertise would likely boost my socializing efforts greatly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact, yes. Recently, there was an incident involving the stovetop at the workshop, and repairs are still ongoing.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Apologies, but I will have to borrow your kitchen once again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Does this mean more delicious Krumkake for me?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: If you wish — but first, I need to prepare some food for a little bird.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, you got a pet bird? When?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Some days ago, a little bird injured its wing and fell to the ground next to the workshop. I noticed it while I was cleaning the house.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I bandaged the wing and built a makeshift nest from some scrap material.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Since it won't be able to hunt for the foreseeable future, I've also been preparing meals for it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what's its favorite food?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Actually, I didn't know what to feed it at first. So, I adopted a trial-and-error approach by presenting ten different foods to choose between.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: In this way, I discovered that it seems to prefer grains and fish over other sources of nutrition.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Since then, I have been using those basic ingredients to prepare different meals for it every day.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: As long as I keep gathering data, I will eventually find out which dish is its favorite.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Well, it's a way to communicate. Animals can't communicate with language like humans can.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: So, I thought I would try feeding it its favorite food. It's an alternate way to show that I care.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you think it understands the gesture?

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: It's definitely grown more reliant on me than when I first took it in. Now, when it sees me, it hops into my hand.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: But at the beginning, it seemed afraid of my metal fingers. It would curl up into a ball when I touched it.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I think so too. It shows that even vastly different lifeforms can develop mutual understanding as long as you find the right way to communicate.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: It is no different with you and I. Every time we interact, I gain new data that helps me to understand you better.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're always welcome to chat with me!

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: I will take you up on that offer. Next time, I would like to try cooking your favorite food based on the information I have gathered to date.

response.speaker: Ineffa
response.text: Who knows if it will be a success... We will have to wait and see.

choices.text: ...That your hands are not cold at all.
Not many people are so meticulous when feeding animals.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}. Did you sleep well? Where would you like to have your breakfast? Do you need me to supply a picnic blanket?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Ineffa.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Good night. Would you prefer aromatherapy, a lullaby, or a bedtime story to help you drift off tonight?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Work environment detected... Cleaning mode activated... No litter or stains detected... Cleaning mode disabled...

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: Apologies. This area is similar to my regular work environment, which has automatically activated my cleaning module... However, I can see you take care to keep things clean.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: So the only "extraneous litter" left here is me... Hmm. Did I set my humor parameters too high again? Your reaction is unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: ...According to my memory banks, this was the style of ceiling I saw when I first opened my eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I have heard that some birds will imprint the first creature they see after hatching as their parent — does this also apply to non-living things?

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: That would explain why my cognition module has developed a special attachment to this environment.
